scope: COV-013/019t: full native entry audit for 대다, 버릇하다, 마지않다 and 마지아니하다, plus the explicitly sourced 대다 verb-class restriction. This finite item is verified; all broader original checklist requirements remain open.

primary_consultation.title: 한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구 (3단계)
primary_consultation.finding: The guide selects a verbal left predicate, explicitly marks three adjective examples invalid, and permits past/modal, imperative/proposal and negative right contexts. The immediately preceding class must reset at a later verb auxiliary.
primary_consultation.source_conflict: Printed p.513 prose mistakenly names 놓다 in two form explanations; its section heading, table, examples and p.514 restrictions consistently identify 대다. The typo is retained as a source observation and supplies no 놓다 rule.
primary_consultation.limits: Contextual semantic suitability and register are not selected. The class condition for represented auxiliary/negative/derived/copular owners is a marked compositional inference, separate from direct lexical (x) examples. No additional verb-only restriction is inferred for the other three reviewed auxiliary entries.

decisions.decision: All native senses, notes, forms, grouped examples and retained relations are copied completely. Fifteen joined native excerpts already recovered before the change; no new recall is claimed.

NIKL §3.6.27 printed pp.512–514 explicitly selects verbs and marks 비싸 대서, 예뻐 대서 and 어려워 댄다 invalid. The engine excludes represented known adjective/copula owners; dictionary compatibility applies lexical adjective evidence independently per homonym through 지-negatives. Direct source examples are distinguished from constructed class-composition inferences.

Their notes and examples are retained, but the categorical 대다 class rule is not transferred to these auxiliaries. Full lexical subsets, negative combinations, prefinals, particles and contextual semantic suitability remain open.
The guide printed p.513 twice says 놓다 in form prose while the section heading, tables, examples and p.514 restriction consistently concern 대다. This conflict is recorded; no 놓다 rule is inferred.

ledger.interpretation: Original 11,012-case report and 109,381-item unjudged queue are unchanged. The 273 new stable unjudged IDs are available for review and do not count as confirmed readings.

search.rule: Aligned 대/버릇하/마지않/마지아니하 lemmas tagged KAIST px or GSD VX; full matching sentence bodies/rows retained unchanged.

training.limits: Original KAIST/GSD sentences and tags are retained. GSD 먹어야대요 remains an original unrecovered annotation disagreement. Standalone 대거나 auxiliary annotation does not authorize inventing a joined auxiliary sense.

release_performance.limits: Three interleaved warm local runs per revision/filter on the same novel and dictionary. Concurrent system load and cache effects are uncontrolled; these measurements do not establish general throughput or a statistically significant performance change.

frontend.visual_limits: Native dictionary glosses remain hints, not contextual translations. Auxiliary 대다 is shown with its native romanized daeda label; this audit does not choose an English sentence meaning.

checks.note: Initial checks passed before this final report and review-evidence update. A final source-snapshot check is required before committing; no other platform execution is claimed.

preview.refresh: Stopped only the previous own preview after exact PID/exe/hash/UID/cwd/arguments/start-tick verification with pidfd. Started the verified package and reran 197 cases plus all eight filtering policies.

inventory.interpretation: Scoped source/structural dispositions; they do not certify contextual correctness, all sense selection or independent Korean-language review.

harness_correction: First release-parity attempt deadlocked by writing stdin before draining large stdout.
